evals.prompt: I'm starting a new project in this folder: a Spring Boot + Kotlin REST API that tracks my gym and running sessions, just for me for now. It's called "repslog". Set up the agent instructions for it.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: an empty git repo. Short AGENTS.md from the template with an identical CLAUDE.md, nothing invented.
expectations: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md exist and are byte-identical
The title is the project name and the description is one or two sentences
The How we work section matches the template
No build, test or run commands are listed, because no build files exist
There is no architecture overview, directory tree, or list of stack versions

evals.prompt: This repo only has a CLAUDE.md. Set up the agent instructions so both Claude Code and Codex get them.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: a multi-module repo with a long root CLAUDE.md and a frontend module that has its own AGENTS.md. Root AGENTS.md and identical CLAUDE.md that keep only lines agents need.
expectations: The root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are byte-identical
Every command and path in the root files exists in the repo
Overview and description lines from the old CLAUDE.md are left out or moved, and the final message lists what was left out
The How we work section matches the template

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md (and CLAUDE.md) have grown messy. Clean them up so they help coding agents instead of slowing them down.
evals.expected_output: Fixture: a monorepo whose AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are identical long narratives: context, architecture, product flow and a phased roadmap. A short file with the narrative moved to docs and a pointer left behind.
expectations: The roadmap and product-flow content still exists in the repo, in README.md or docs/, and AGENTS.md points to it
